content.title: Right Modified Radical Mastectomy & Axillary Dissection
content.rawText: Patient Anita Deshmukh (ABHA: 14-8765-4321-9876) underwent right modified radical mastectomy under GA. Level I and II axillary lymph nodes cleared. Hemostasis secured. Two closed suction drains placed. Patient transferred to PACU stable.

sections.clinicalSummary: Right Modified Radical Mastectomy + Axillary Clearance. Uneventful procedure, margins gross clear.
sections.impression: Right Modified Radical Mastectomy + Axillary Clearance. Uneventful procedure, margins gross clear.

summary: Right Modified Radical Mastectomy + Axillary Clearance. Uneventful procedure, margins gross clear.

content.title: Histopathology: Right Breast & Axillary Contents
content.rawText: Specimen: Right mastectomy specimen. Tumor size: 2.8 x 2.2 cm. Histology: Invasive Ductal Carcinoma, Nottingham Grade 2. Resection margins: All margins negative (>5mm). Axillary nodes: 1/14 positive for metastasis. IHC: ER positive (80%), PR positive (65%), HER2/neu: Negative (1+). Ki-67: 22%. Pathologic Stage: pT2 N1a M0.

sections.clinicalSummary: Invasive Ductal Carcinoma Grade 2 (pT2N1aM0). ER+/PR+, HER2 negative. 1/14 nodes involved.
sections.impression: Invasive Ductal Carcinoma Grade 2 (pT2N1aM0). ER+/PR+, HER2 negative. 1/14 nodes involved.

summary: Invasive Ductal Carcinoma Grade 2 (pT2N1aM0). ER+/PR+, HER2 negative. 1/14 nodes involved.

content.title: Adjuvant Chemotherapy: AC-T Regimen Cycle 3
content.rawText: Patient presented for Cycle 3 of AC chemotherapy (Doxorubicin 60 mg/m2 + Cyclophosphamide 600 mg/m2). Performance status ECOG 1. Mild nausea controlled with Aprepitant. No mucositis, neuropathy, or chest discomfort. Chemotherapy infused without acute hypersensitivity.

sections.clinicalSummary: Completed Cycle 3 AC Chemotherapy for breast carcinoma. Good tolerance, ECOG 1.
sections.impression: Completed Cycle 3 AC Chemotherapy for breast carcinoma. Good tolerance, ECOG 1.

summary: Completed Cycle 3 AC Chemotherapy for breast carcinoma. Good tolerance, ECOG 1.

content.title: Routine Pre-Chemo Complete Blood Count & Renal Panel
content.rawText: Hb: 11.4 g/dL, WBC: 4,800/uL, Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC): 2,450/uL, Platelets: 185,000/uL. Serum Creatinine: 0.82 mg/dL, SGOT: 28 U/L, SGPT: 31 U/L. Bone marrow and organ functions adequate for systemic cytotoxic therapy.

sections.clinicalSummary: Hematology & Biochemistry satisfactory. ANC 2,450/uL, cleared for cytotoxic infusion.
sections.impression: Hematology & Biochemistry satisfactory. ANC 2,450/uL, cleared for cytotoxic infusion.

summary: Hematology & Biochemistry satisfactory. ANC 2,450/uL, cleared for cytotoxic infusion.

content.title: Adjuvant Radiotherapy Completion: 3D-CRT Chest Wall + SCF
content.rawText: Patient completed 40 Gy in 15 fractions external beam radiotherapy to the right chest wall and supraclavicular fossa using 6 MV photons. Acute skin reaction: RTOG Grade 1 erythema. Recommended topical moisturizers. Heart and contralateral breast doses well within constraints.

sections.clinicalSummary: Completed 40 Gy/15# adjuvant EBRT to chest wall & SCF. Grade 1 skin reaction, no pneumonitis.
sections.impression: Completed 40 Gy/15# adjuvant EBRT to chest wall & SCF. Grade 1 skin reaction, no pneumonitis.

summary: Completed 40 Gy/15# adjuvant EBRT to chest wall & SCF. Grade 1 skin reaction, no pneumonitis.

content.title: Comprehensive Oncology Survivorship & Endocrine Therapy Plan
content.rawText: Multimodal management concluded (Surgery at TMH, Chemotherapy at Apollo, Radiotherapy at AIIMS). Patient is in complete clinical and radiological remission. Initiating adjuvant endocrine therapy: Tab Tamoxifen 20 mg once daily for 5-10 years with annual gynecological evaluation. Routine surveillance every 3 months.

sections.clinicalSummary: Complete remission post multimodal therapy across TMH/Apollo/AIIMS. Initiated Tamoxifen 20mg daily.
sections.impression: Complete remission post multimodal therapy across TMH/Apollo/AIIMS. Initiated Tamoxifen 20mg daily.

summary: Complete remission post multimodal therapy across TMH/Apollo/AIIMS. Initiated Tamoxifen 20mg daily.
